summary: Important: .NET 8.0 security, bug fix, and enhancement update
details:
.NET is a fast, lightweight and modular platform for creating cross platform applications that work on Linux, macOS and Windows.  It particularly focuses on creating console applications, web applications and micro-services.  .NET contains a runtime conforming to .NET Standards a set of framework libraries, an SDK containing compilers and a 'dotnet' application to drive everything.

SDK version: 8.0.133
Runtime version: 8.0.33

Security Fix(es):

* brotli: Out-of-Bounds Write in Google Brotli Decoder (CVE-2026-111497)

* dotnet8.0: dotnet9.0: dotnet11.0: dotnet10.0: ASP.NET Core Elevation of Privilege Vulnerability (CVE-2026-114148)

Bug Fix(es) and Enhancement(s):

* Update .NET 8.0 to SDK 8.0.133 and Runtime 8.0.33 [rhel-10.2.z] (JIRA:Rocky Linux-291718)

For more details about the security issue(s), including the impact, a CVSS score, acknowledgments, and other related information, refer to the CVE page(s) listed in the References section.
